single_variable: Split each opened short equally by quantity between the frozen nearer cap4 target and original near first-week boundary. Both legs retain the same absolute stop and 168-hour timeout. When the boundary is within 4%, both exit at the boundary.
account: 1000 USDT. At most five contracts and 10% initial combined parent notional per signal, same priority, collateral, fees and stress as baseline; an occupied slot remains busy through the final exit hour.
stress: 5bp adverse slippage on market fills on the same native barriers. Funding and lot rounding excluded.
order: Reuse frozen cap4 exits. Apply the same reconciled 1m tape to the runner exit hour when available; open before range and high first within an unresolved candle. At the 168-hour deadline use only the open.
